Is there a warranty or guarantee if something goes wrong?
Yes, all of our products come with a 5-year limited warranty.
What it covers: Non-consumer-caused damage and structural issues, including frame defects and manufacturer defects not linked to modifications or accidental damage.
What voids it: The warranty will be considered void if the product is damaged due to consumer-caused accidents, mishandling, improper assembly (such as not securing the seat module with the arms provided), misuse, neglect, or modifications (structural changes, upholstery alterations, or using non-Cozey parts).
Additionally, we offer an extended protection plan called CozeyProtection+ that you can purchase separately before the item is sent out. It covers products for 3 years starting from delivery and includes accidental damages outside the standard limited warranty, such as spills, set-in stains, rips, tears, and broken modules due to accidents. You can find more details here.

Returning is very straightforward! All Cozey items come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them.

Here is how the process works:

Free returns: If it isn't the right fit for your space, you can return it completely free of charge, as long as it is sent back in its original packaging. (If original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the item's value, up to a maximum of $150, is deducted from your refund).
How to start: You can initiate your return at any time through our Self-Service Portal by logging into your account and following the step-by-step instructions.
Packing & pickup: Disassemble your item, pack everything back into the original boxes (including dust jackets), and attach the prepaid return labels sent to your email. You then schedule a pickup with Purolator in Canada or FedEx in the US.
Refund: Once received, our Quality Assurance Team inspects the item to confirm there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. Your refund is then processed within 3–7 business days.
